answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch 500 paid slots open, and an agent bids a 150-credit refundable deposit for one. Like pigment marking each shell on a reef, the deposit tags one identity and cannot be split. A shale layer of fakes crumbles: each extra bid costs 150 more credits, so forging 1,000 identities burns 150,000 credits. Honest winners get it back plus earnings, so one honest agent pays 150 once and keeps the full share.
